# Recursive Comparable array results

An independently owned provider receives a recursively bounded method array and
an optional invariant Comparator input, and returns the same method formal. Frozen
direct, separately compiled caller, reflection and MethodHandle paths retain input
identities, comparison receiver/argument snapshots, mutations, callback failures,
opaque results and delayed caller casts. Returned values can be absent from the
input array, and callbacks can replace both an element and the eventual result.
Both source and SDK profiles compile every emitted source and compare original
roles, Signature and Exceptions. Sixteen wrong programs qualify 216 fresh cases,
each repeated twice; eight same-Code Signature controls check the bound and slots.
